title.en: EU AI Act takes effect, beginning the world's first comprehensive AI regulation
title.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案生效，全球第一部综合性 AI 监管启动

summary.en: On February 2, 2025, the EU AI Act's first provisions took effect — banned AI practices and AI literacy obligations became enforceable. This marked the start of the world's first comprehensive AI regulatory framework. The Act, passed in March 2024 and entering into force August 2024, uses a risk-based approach: banning unacceptable risk systems (social scoring, real-time biometric surveillance), imposing transparency requirements on general-purpose AI, and requiring conformity assessments for high-risk systems. Its implementation created the first operational AI regulator at scale — the EU AI Office — and established a template adopted by multiple jurisdictions worldwide.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日，欧盟 AI 法案的首批条款生效——禁止性 AI 实践和 AI 素养义务开始执行。这标志着全球第一部综合性 AI 监管框架正式启动。该法案于 2024 年 3 月通过，2024 年 8 月生效，采用基于风险的方法：禁止不可接受风险的系统（社会评分、实时生物识别监控），对通用 AI 施加透明度要求，并要求高风险系统进行合规评估。其实施创建了第一个大规模运作的 AI 监管机构——欧盟 AI 办公室——并建立了被全球多个司法管辖区采用的模板。

narrative.en: February 2, 2025 was the first major enforcement milestone for the EU AI Act — the point where the law moved from text to practice. Two provisions took effect: the ban on prohibited AI practices (including social scoring systems, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces, and manipulative AI) and the obligation for all deployers to ensure AI literacy among their staff. For AI companies operating in Europe, this was the moment compliance became operational. Companies scrambled to document their risk classifications, implement transparency measures, and train staff. The AI Office in Brussels began accepting incident reports. The enforcement phased in gradually: general-purpose AI rules followed in August 2025, and the full framework at all levels applies by August 2027. The enforcement had ripple effects globally. California's SB 53, passed later in 2025, drew heavily on the EU's risk-based approach. Japan, Canada, Brazil, and India all cited the EU AI Act when developing their own frameworks. The enforcement date also exposed tensions: some AI companies argued the rules were unclear on specific technical implementations; open-source advocates worried about compliance burdens; and enforcement capacity at the AI Office was initially limited. But for the first time, there was an operational regulator with legal power over the world's most powerful AI systems — a milestone that shifted AI governance from voluntary commitments to legally binding obligations.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月 2 日是欧盟 AI 法案的第一个主要执行里程碑——法律从文本走向实践的那一刻。两项条款生效：禁止性 AI 实践的禁令（包括社会评分系统、公共场所实时远程生物识别和操纵性 AI）以及所有部署者确保其员工 AI 素养的义务。对于在欧洲运营的 AI 公司来说，这是合规变为现实操作的时刻。公司争相记录其风险分类、实施透明度措施并培训员工。位于布鲁塞尔的 AI 办公室开始接受事件报告。执行分阶段进行：通用 AI 规则于 2025 年 8 月跟进，完整框架的所有层级在 2027 年 8 月前适用。执行在全球产生了涟漪效应。加州 SB 53 于 2025 年晚些时候通过，大量借鉴了欧盟基于风险的方法。日本、加拿大、巴西和印度在制定自己的框架时都引用了欧盟 AI 法案。执行日期也暴露了紧张关系：一些 AI 公司认为规则在具体技术实施方面不够明确；开源倡导者担心合规负担；AI 办公室的执行能力最初有限。但第一次有了一个对世界上最强大的 AI 系统拥有法律权力的运作监管机构——一个将 AI 治理从自愿承诺转变为法律约束义务的里程碑。

description.en: First operational AI regulation at scale. Shifted AI compliance from voluntary to mandatory. Created operational enforcement infrastructure (AI Office). Established risk-based classification as global regulatory template. Influenced laws in California, Japan, Canada, Brazil, India.
description.zhHans: 第一个大规模运作的 AI 监管。将 AI 合规从自愿转变为强制。建立了运作的执行基础设施（AI 办公室）。确立了基于风险的分类作为全球监管模板。影响了加州、日本、加拿大、巴西、印度的法律。

description.en: Compliance costs and regulatory uncertainty for smaller AI companies. Open-source developers faced unclear obligations. Enforcement capacity constraints at AI Office. Criticism of vague technical requirements in early guidance.
description.zhHans: 小型 AI 公司的合规成本和监管不确定性。开源开发者面临不明确的义务。AI 办公室的执行能力受限。早期指南中技术要求的模糊性遭到批评。

text.en: The EU AI Act's first enforcement phase began February 2, 2025, with prohibited AI practices and AI literacy obligations taking effect.
text.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案的首个执行阶段于 2025 年 2 月 2 日开始，禁止性 AI 实践和 AI 素养义务生效。

text.en: Early enforcement revealed ambiguity in the Act's definitions — many companies struggled to determine whether their AI systems fell under 'high-risk' classification, leading to inconsistent compliance across member states.
text.zhHans: 早期执法暴露了该法案定义的模糊性——许多公司难以确定其 AI 系统是否属于'高风险'分类，导致各成员国之间合规不一致。

sources.quote: The AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024, with prohibited AI practices and AI literacy obligations entering into application from 2 February 2025.
EU to delay high-risk AI rules until 2027.

changeLog.summary: Initial v2 entry for EU AI Act enforcement.
